verdict.reason: Isolated serial measurement (npm run test:e2e:perf, single Playwright worker, no sibling worker) gives p95 257.5ms <= 500ms — PASS with ~1.94x margin, consistent with the two earlier standalone runs (263.2ms / 282.8ms) and the in-process kernel (109.7ms). The two full-suite overshoots (527.4ms run A, 649.2ms run B) are retained above and remain explained as measurement contamination, NOT a product defect: in each full-suite run the last ~5 timings fall back to the standalone range (run A runs 26-30: 144.9-268.7ms; run B runs 26-30: 163.5-210.4ms) once the sibling worker finished — the inflation is parallel-worker CPU contention on this 1.5-vCPU shared VM. T012-FIX-01 split the E2E suite into `functional` and `perf` Playwright projects so `npm run test:e2e` no longer includes the perf test and the perf test runs alone by `npm run test:e2e:perf`. Same table (32x12), same 30-run method, same 500ms threshold, same assertion — only the measurement isolation changed.
